# aphrody-env

<!-- catalog:begin unit -->
> Zero-dependency Rust 2024 loader and SecretString redaction guard for C:/src/.env

| Type | Path |
| :-- | :-- |
| Rust crate | `src/env` |

**Commands**

```sh

```

Rust builds run on the build host or in CI, not on a workstation.
